en: My husband went off to Meteor Falls with some people in red. They said they wanted to see his meteorite...
He can't say no to anyone. I hope he's all right.
My husband's been so down since his meteorite was taken. I do feel sorry for him.
My husband's so happy to have his meteorite back! Thank you, truly.
My meteorite... It will never be mine again now. Team Magma made off with it.
Is that... my meteorite? You got it back! May I have it, please?
Give the Meteorite to Prof. Cozmo?
Thank you! Please, take this TM in return.
With the meteorite back, my research can go on. You've helped me more than you know!
Oh... I see. I'm crushed, but I understand.
